notes.title: ⚡Update Roadmap Revealed!
notes.content:
🎮Update Roadmap Revealed!
Thank you for playing the two‑in‑one 2D action‑date game“CONERU ‑DIMENSION GIRL‑”!  
Your purchases and many 👍 reviews keep our dev team motivated to improve the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44635243/4c0077aa7b0c9bc85801e24f7ff99ab8343b567f.png

*Please note that the schedule and contents may change depending on development circumstances.

QoL Update (2025.6‑8)
From June through August we’ll release updates focused on improving usability.


👿 Penalty Rule Revision

Your HP now fully recovers whenever you change stages.  
In Phase 3 you can also choose “Retry from the very start of the stage.”  


💰 Weapon Price Adjustment

Lower weapon prices so you can easily try out different gear.  


⚡ Run‑Run Mode Timer Pause

The Run‑Run gauge no longer decreases while the map is open or when choosing a lightning rod.  


📍 Map Improvements

You can now zoom the map while it’s open and when selecting a warp point.  


🎮“Quit Game”Improvement

Quitting mid‑stage now saves your buffs, weapons, beam, money and EXP.  
Resuming starts from the stage’s starting point.  


🍩 Run‑Run Timer Recovery

Eating a donut during Run‑Run Mode restores the remaining timer.  


🎮 Free Stage Travel

After clearing the main game you can freely move to any stage of each phase.  


🎮 Score Attack Mode Added

Unlocked after clearing the game.  


🎮 Achievements & Trading Cards  

Steam‑only achievements and trading cards will be implemented.  


Free Major Update!! (2025.9)
A free major update lands in **September**!  
New bosses, branching scenarios, date spots, Coneru‑Beams, Coneru‑Talk and more free content!  
Full details will appear in an August release note—stay tuned 🍩⚡

notes.title: CONERU -Development Note- #14
notes.content:
Thank you for playing the demo!
We hope you're enjoying your 2D action-date adventure with Coneru!

⚡
We’re excited to announce an update to the demo (now Demo_ver1.01), which includes the following fixes and adjustments:

General Changes

Increased the attack power of all weapons and the Conerun Beam.
Reduced the stat boost provided by the upgraded lightning rods.
Removed the "Capsule Bomb" from the Conerun Beam (it’s currently being adjusted).
DEMO PLAY

Added more healing items in Stage 1.
Increased the number of upgraded lightning rods in Stage 1.
Fixed a bug where players could get stuck in the concrete blocks in Stage 1.
Increased the HP of the "Site Foreman" boss.
TIME ATTACK

Increased the number of upgraded lightning rods in Stage 1.
Updated the Site Foreman’s text to display "180 seconds" for the time limit.
Fixed a bug where players could get stuck in the concrete blocks in Stage 1.
We will continue to fine-tune the parameters and healing mechanics based on your feedback. Please feel free to share your thoughts on our community hub, as we’ll use them as a reference for future adjustments.
⚡

We’re committed to improving the game and making your 2D action-date experience with Coneru even more fun, exciting, and smooth! Thank you for your continued support of CONERU -DIMENSION GIRL-.

notes.title: CONERU -Development Note- #7
notes.content:
Konjikino Machi
She is a powerful woman who serves as the mayor of the metropolis of Shinjuku City.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44635243/29f5b43706c82dd09a94daf128555c548b40eb14.png

She is a former Japanese champion women's professional wrestler. She spent her childhood in Shinjyuku City, where her last retirement match was held. Her love for her hometown is strong, and she is well supported by the local residents.
She and Dr. Otsukimi are old acquaintances and have worked together many times to solve many difficult problems. In the current game, she is working together with the few remaining residents of Shinjyuku City to formulate a plan to confront the "Hate Fruit Company," a more difficult enemy than ever before.


The greatest enemy in the history of Shinjyuku 
She is both a man of courage, who, under the guise of "information gathering," goes into the mother ship on his own, and a cool-headed strategist, who uses the information he gathers to devise a strategy for winning the war. Although this is a winning pattern, using she own sturdiness as a shield, the "Hate Fruit Company" was indeed a bad opponent this time, and he suffered a serious injury, breaking a bone in her leg. Still undaunted, She was planning Her next strategy, but...?

notes.title: CONERU -Development Note- #6
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44635243/5d93fef4e0219dcc5c35c15392a596445333af4a.jpg

Dr. Otsukimi
He is the guardian of Socrates and CONERU. He is called "Dr. Otsukimi" because of the shape of his unruly hair, which cannot be fixed no matter how hard he tries. He usually stays in his laboratory in Shinjuku City, working on some mysterious research. He is a night owl and does not like sunlight, so a parasol is indispensable when he goes out in the daytime. His research specialties are the interaction of consciousness and matter, the conversion of thoughts into plasma energy, and the proof of the existence of transcendental extra space and how to interfere with it, which he does not understand. His favorite snacks are soda pop and hot milk.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44635243/1f28544f845f49789ea96f0fc02e7a5032d89c66.gif

↑When I'm concentrating, I never notice how much CONERU and Socrates are flailing about.


Rather sociable personality.
He has been contributing to society through inventions and advice that have nothing to do with research for the people of the city, and he was also gradually working on countermeasures against the current Hate Fruit Company invasion, exchanging information with the mayor of Shinjyuku. The mayor of Shinjyuku likes him so much that he often asks him to do things he doesn't want to do, but he responds to his requests by working hard despite the pressure, which creates a vicious cycle (or is it a virtuous cycle?) of being asked to do even more. Dr. Otsukimi named this phenomenon "Muchabring Cyclone," and the mayor, impressed by the name, became even more fond of Dr. Otsukimi. (The mayor is a former professional women's wrestler.)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44635243/3e424ed9762cde108fe748fbd5e16cd841fa773a.gif

↑He is basically a quiet person, but when he discovers something or gets a result of his research, he gets excited even in the morning.

notes.title: CONERU -Development Note- #4
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44635243/ba014f541effe3a8ffcab6b3c270926cc1af574a.png

CONERU with you, using one body for both of us
The format is a 2D platform action game. In order to liberate Sinjukushi City, you will run freely around the stage and defeat your enemies. ......, but at the same time, you are not the only one with your own body. This is a "2D action date" in which you and Knead use a single body. The influence of her existing in another dimension will be beyond your imagination. In this article, we will briefly explain the four systems that create such a 2D action date!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44635243/2ec325806cc55dc712e8ff15efa1112b37a15894.png

Conerun Talk: Conerun talks about various events!
CONERU, which is playing along with you, is always displayed in the lower left corner of the screen (just like a live game player) and shows a variety of reactions. If your ship is damaged, she will make a face of pain and say "Ouch", or she will eat a doughnut and smile, saying "I'm getting so happy! and smile after eating a donut, or if left unattended for a long time...? The variety of reactions that you will see will make your 2D action date so exciting that it will be difficult to see all of them by the time you finish the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44635243/55fb9ad54881dea8c3799f6f67a62f9901a9ab74.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44635243/ec19a45cbdedfafd03f3419b0306ae3ddc3bea88.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44635243/8d8e59c24c385be431eaf9dc6a8c575098961539.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44635243/01335aa5b5f8f322349786eb5348d4ffcbfaec5e.png

Run-Run mode: The energy of CONERU explodes!
CONERU loves donuts! When the "Run-Run Gauge" that accumulates from acquiring "Concept Donuts" that appear throughout the stage reaches its maximum, the enormous energy contained within CONERU will cause your mobility to explode. A high-speed run that blasts away enemies with just a touch, a heaven-breathing super-jump, and an lightning dash, you can do whatever you want for as long as you want (or until she feels like it) until the gauge is fully consumed. Whether you want to be dictated to by this jockey mode...or let yourself be dictated to by it...or ride it out...it's all up to you!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44635243/0e2575f4a0412093e9019ed96ed1d3949b10586a.png
When the Run-Run gauge reaches MAX, "Run-Run mode" is activated!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44635243/b77bea3e2176ae47995bcc1d7b06ae4bacac6d91.png
During Run-Run mode, blocks that are normally unbreakable are destroyed with ease!


Conerun Beam: A strange flying device that changes one after another depending on her mood, and does not look like a beam!
There are two means of attack in this game. One by you and one by CONERU. You can of course choose your own means of attack, but in the same way, CONERU chooses her own means of attack. Each time the circular beam gauge makes a round, the means of attack changes one after another, depending on her mood. Sometimes the choice makes you think, "Nice! or "That pick at this point? or "That pick in this situation! Such joys and sorrows are one of the best parts of an action date with CONERU!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44635243/c9c9f68f14e394df5e8f80ec2ceff8de8b3b8caa.gif
The "Fuuma Shuriken" return trip deals damage, and the return trip follows the ship back to its own location!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44635243/aa4805a80eebf3d1e8782bfe507f010cd78ab80b.gif
"Bowling" A ball that crawls on the ground, bouncing off enemies like pins. If you hit it well, you will be hit many times!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44635243/06743affe32b1a62b130f1e11352b8bbbbf21888.gif
It will include 30 types of beams, such as "Kaminari-sama," which delivers a double electric shock from a lightning strike to a shockwave!


Date Spot: CONERU, who has come to Earth for sightseeing, is curious about various things on stage!
CONERU originally came to Earth to sightsee. In each stage, there are several date spots hidden to entertain her. You can enjoy a little conversation with CONERU when you find them, and through these experiences, you can come up with new Conerun beams or obtain powerful items. Enjoy the road trip as much as you can, but don't forget the purpose of saving Shinjyuku.


Please look forward to a more detailed description of each system when it is further developed!

notes.title: CONERU -Development Note- #3
notes.content:
Hate Fruits Company
One day in Shinjuku City, the setting of this work, a mysterious group of super nuisances suddenly appears. They seem to be a corporate organization, and their "city wreaking" is a crude and unscrupulous act using cheat-level scientific power that makes one wonder if they have God on their side, and there is not an ounce of style in their tactics. On Saturdays and Sundays, they are quiet because they are closed, but on weekdays, from Monday to Friday, they are full of energy, spreading their harassment. The fact that their purpose itself is a mystery adds to the annoyance. Thanks to this, most of the town's residents have moved away.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44635243/3732629731b7117ccaf1d798fefc89d3aa47b65c.gif

Boss: Hyde le Necryptus
The boss of the Hate Fruits Company. He is a jerk who has no ideology or justice, but simply enjoys aggression and annoyance. His personality is very self-centered and narcissistic. He sometimes throws childish tantrums when he doesn't get his way.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44635243/ed75db18c5fb91fb6741633529741eac91a3e12a.gif

Combatant: Sisaku
These androids have been trained in HFC's corporate philosophy, "Today, too, we are energetically annoying." Many of them have cheerful personalities and are somewhat hard to hate. They have no standards of right and wrong, and follow only the orders of executives. Since their individual abilities are not very high, they are a sad group of people who are supposed to be disposable.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44635243/c0b879ed119a58695da2f83234dcb199280f0c6a.gif

notes.title: CONERU -Development Note- #2
notes.content:
Socrates.
Like Subspace Kone, he is a combat android who is the protagonist of this work.
He lives in a laboratory in Shinjukushi City with his benefactor, Dr. Otukimi. While undergoing maintenance as usual, Konekuru suddenly inhabits his body, and the two of them end up sharing one body.

Mystery of the power source
As an android, Socrates' power source is a mystery, and he was unable to move satisfactorily until he was inhabited by Koneru. By becoming one with Koneru, Socrates was able to harbor an enormous amount of energy in his body, giving him the power and mobility to take on his arch-enemy, the Hate Fruit Company.

The benefactor is Dr. Otsukimi.
He met Dr. Otukimi, with whom he lives, at a scrap yard.
Dr. Otukimi happened to be passing by and offered a helping hand to Socrates, who was left in a pile of junk, just waiting to be disposed of. After undergoing extensive maintenance in the lab, Socrates was restored to health, although his mobility was not as good as it had been. Perhaps as a reaction to his abandonment, Dr. Otukimi's love for Socrates helped to calm his troubled heart, which had been in a state of frenzy when they first met.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44635243/e96602b02394443a98e2a88cd837a25b13fbb546.gif

Defeat Hate Fruit Company
Socrates then becomes very eager to help Dr. Otukimi. With the pride of being a combat android, he decides to take down the Hate Fruit Company, which is causing trouble for everyone in Shinjukushi City!

She is a naive and fast-paced character. Her trademark is her inazuma-shaped eyes and large spiral twin-tail hair. Her hair ornament in the shape of Saturn, which she made herself as a hobby, is said to be the same size as the real Saturn (in other words, she may be terribly huge...).

Hobbies include dimensional travel
Her hobby is dimensional travel, in which she incarnates herself as a soul into a life form or substance somewhere in the universe, thereby moving through all of space and time. She can cause such subspace travel on her own, but she is inexperienced in controlling it...so she often uses the services of a dimensional travel company.

Unexpected trouble
For this trip, she had arranged for a "fluffy plan" to be born on earth as the soul of a cat, but due to a mistake by the dimensional travel agency, she ended up incarnating an artificial life form that would normally not be able to harbor a soul.
